title: Somnia
location: Le Guess Who? Utrecht · Centraal Museum Utrecht · MUTEK MX · Artweek Mexico · Inspace Mexico · Het Houtenhuis
excerpt: An interdisciplinary audiovisual dance performance exploring dream states and the human body.
description:
> Somnia is an interdisciplinary audiovisual dance performance collaboratively created by Mexican contemporary dancer and choreographer Alejandra Metztli and Dutch immersive digital artist Jaco Schilp. The project delves into the poetic processes within the human body and explores the dream states experienced during sleep. It presents a multidimensional approach to movement language, reflecting a non-linear and energetic interpretation of timeless realities.
> Inspired by the chemical substances secreted by the human brain, neuronal frequencies, and the subtle body connected to dream narratives, Somnia integrates these elements to craft a unique artistic expression.
The piece is a collaboration between a dancer and interactive visuals with sound, controlled by digital scanners. It is driven by the interaction between body movement and real-time processes in the computer, which together create the complete performance. The sound design for the performance was developed in collaboration with Ben Spaander (Cosmic Force) and Noah Zurhaar, adding a layered auditory dimension to the experience.
Somnia is the result of an international artistic residency, supported by the Sistema de Apoyos a la Creación y Proyectos Culturales of the Mexican government. The residency took place at Uncloud, Netherlands, in 2024.
credits: Choreography & direction: Alejandra Metztli. Sound design: Ben Spaander (Cosmic Force) and Noah Zurhaar. Photography: Guillaume Versteeg.
